rules.statement: The added defendant, Gira Etana, is entitled to one-third of the land based on her subsequent bina marriage in Kitanhamy's lifetime.
rules.supporting_quote: "This would, therefore, give the added defendant the whole one-fourth derivable from Ukkuhamy. The judgment of the District Judge must therefore be amended by awarding 1/12 + 1/4 or 4/12 to the added defendant = 1/3 claimed in the appeal."
